tags.VIDEO_HOOK: The very first hook of the entire video — a shock thesis promising the full episode.
tags.VIDEO_PROMISE: Overall value promise for the whole video (what the viewer will learn by the end).
tags.VIDEO_OUTRO: Final point of the entire video — summary, moral, emotional closing for the whole episode.
tags.STORY_BOUNDARY: STRICT technical marker: EXACTLY once per story in the video. Fires ONLY in the block where the proper name of a specific technical object/device — the hero of that story — is first mentioned (exact make/model/index or established nickname of that object). Do NOT use for place names, eras, organizations, time periods, or other dramatic turns (e.g. 'Afghanistan', 'early seventies', 'Ministry of Defense') — even if a vivid new arc starts there, that is NOT a new hero, so NOT STORY_BOUNDARY (use ARC_OPEN). If there was a teaser without a name before the explicit naming ('there was a machine, assembled flawlessly...') — that teaser is NOT STORY_BOUNDARY, tag it OPEN_LOOP. Any REPEAT mentions of an already named hero later in the text — also NOT STORY_BOUNDARY, even if scene/location/drama changes (use ARC_OPEN). Mentioning a hero from the PREVIOUS story inside TRANSITION_BRIDGE — also NOT STORY_BOUNDARY.
tags.ARC_OPEN: Start of a sub-arc WITHIN an ongoing story (e.g. beginning of a segment about a specific technical problem of the same machine) — NOT for boundaries between stories; use STORY_BOUNDARY for that.
tags.ARC_CLOSE: Final point of a sub-arc (moral/conclusion on a specific problem or on the whole story if it is the last block before moving to the next).
tags.TRANSITION_BRIDGE: Bridge between two stories: closes the previous topic and thematically prepares the next, without a separate OPEN_LOOP/CLOSE_LOOP.
tags.QUESTION_STACK: Series of 2+ rhetorical questions in a row without answers, building intrigue.
tags.OPEN_LOOP: Opening a specific intrigue/mystery whose answer will come later (not to be confused with QUESTION_STACK — here a specific promised fact is fixed).
tags.CLOSE_LOOP: Reveal/answer to a previously opened loop (OPEN_LOOP).
tags.CONTEXT: Necessary background/historical context for understanding the plot.
tags.FALSE_PROMISE: A 'everything seems fine' moment — false sense of wellbeing before a break/turn.
tags.TURN: Turning point: moment where illusion/expectation crashes into reality.
tags.TENSION: Building tension — description of problem, risk, conflict, rising danger.
tags.TENSION_PEAK: Climactic tension point within an episode (not necessarily the whole story) — the most emotionally intense moment of a specific scene.
tags.PROOF: Argument, demonstration, number, fact supporting the thesis.
tags.MICRO_PAYOFF: Intermediate partial payoff that relieves some tension but does not close the whole story.
tags.SCENE: Specific illustrative mini-episode/scene with action (not abstract reasoning).
tags.RELIEF: Emotional release after a dense block (in this genre often bitter humor, not light).
tags.PACING_BEAT: Short rhythmic connector phrase without new information, keeping pace.
tags.CTA: Direct call to action (subscribe, like, comment, click).
tags.CUSTOM: Custom tag when no standard tag fits.
